_comment: Growing corpus for [[de-model-public-writing-over-time]]. This file IS the 'adapt over time' state: append ONE entry per newly-caught tell and every future partner-facing draft is scrubbed against the larger set, no code change. regex_tells flag the matching snippet; semantic_checklist is a short nudge injected on every partner-facing draft write. Keep regex HIGH-PRECISION -- a false-positive gate gets ignored like a boy who cried wolf, same discipline as the em-dash gate staying silent unless a real em-dash is present. Origin: Will 2026-07-29, jubrlee flagged the WGlynn randomness post (ethresearch thread 25556) as 'LLM confusion' -- on FORM not correctness.

regex_tells.pattern: (?i)\b(i initially (?:thought|said|conflated|wrote|assumed)|on (?:second thought|reflection)|correction:|scratch that|let me correct|i (?:mis|over)stated|to be clear,? i (?:meant|should have))\b
regex_tells.why: Visible self-correction / showing your work. The strongest LLM tell. A human posts the corrected version clean; the walk-back happens off-thread (in the verify workflow), never in the post.

regex_tells.pattern: (?i)(?:credit to|hat[- ]tip|building on the work of|as (?:noted|shown) by)\b[^.\n]*,[^.\n]*,
regex_tells.why: Dumping 3+ citations in one breath to preempt 'you didn't invent this'. One cite if load-bearing, otherwise none.
Qualifier on qualifier (the exact tell jubrlee caught in thread 25556). Take the position.

semantic_checklist: LAND-NOT-DERIVE: strip any correction, hedge, or scaffolding; post only the landed result.
OVER-SYMMETRY: models cover every case and balance every hand. Leave some out and pick a side.
RHYTHM: vary paragraph length and shape; uniform blocks read generated.
LISTICLE: fold numbered lists into flowing prose unless it is a genuine enumeration a human would number.

RESIGNED-GAP: if the draft says our design is weaker, worse or limited next to a reference (nature, another system, the ideal), do not stop there. Name the move that closes the gap, or say exactly why it cannot close. A named gap is a target, not a conclusion.

THEIR-DOMAIN: lead with the recipient's own technology and words, and show how it fits Noesis like a glove (Bernhard 2026-10-19: "a blockchain out of small brains" landed where architecture explanations never did). Cut our internal vocabulary (three tokens, PoM mix, layer names) unless they asked for it. The insight they reach in their own terms is the one that lands.
